home.subtitle: Step-by-step video guides for every appliance in your home. Easy to follow, in 4 languages.

frame55: Connect the power cable to the back of the TV and plug into wall socket
Press the power button on the remote or on the TV itself
Follow the on-screen setup wizard to connect to WiFi
Use the Home button on the remote to access Smart TV features
Adjust picture settings via Menu → Picture → Expert Settings
crystal43: Connect HDMI cable from your device to the HDMI port on the TV
Press Source button on remote to select the correct input
Use the volume buttons on the right side of the TV or remote
Access picture mode via Settings → General → Accessibility
Set up subtitles via Menu → General → Accessibility → Caption Settings
neoqled65: Mount the TV on the wall using the included VESA mount bracket
Connect the One Connect Box using the supplied cable
Power on and complete the Smart Hub setup
Connect to Bixby voice assistant by holding the microphone button
Use Multi View to watch two sources simultaneously

oledc3: Attach the stand by aligning it with the bottom of the TV
Connect power and press the power button
Follow initial setup to connect to your home network
Access webOS Home by pressing the Home button
Enable ThinQ AI features through the settings menu
nanocell50: Place TV on stand and connect power cable
Press power on remote to turn on
Sign in to LG account for full Smart TV access

bravia55: Connect the power cord and all cables before turning on
Press the power button on the remote
Select your language on the welcome screen
Sign in to your Google account for Android TV features

serie6oven: Before first use, heat the empty oven at 250C for 1 hour
Turn the function selector to choose your cooking mode
Set temperature using the temperature dial
Press the clock button to set cooking duration
The oven will beep when preheated to the set temperature
serie4microwave: Set power level using the power button
Enter cooking time using the number pad
Allow food to stand 1-2 minutes before serving

bespokefridge: Allow fridge to stand upright for 2 hours before plugging in
Set temperature to 4C for fridge and -18C for freezer
Connect to WiFi via the Family Hub screen
Use the ice maker by pressing the ice type button

serie6washing: Sort laundry by color and fabric type
Load laundry loosely — do not overfill
Add detergent to the correct drawer compartment
Select wash program using the dial
Press Start/Pause button to begin cycle

ecobubble: Load clothes into the drum without overfilling
Add detergent to the detergent drawer

perfera: Point remote at the unit and press ON/OFF button
Press MODE to select Cool, Heat, Fan or Dry
Use the temperature arrows to set desired temperature
Press FAN to adjust fan speed
Use TIMER to schedule automatic on/off times

mszap: Press the ON/OFF button on the remote to start
Select operating mode using the MODE button
Adjust temperature with the TEMP buttons
Press the FAN button to change fan speed
Use the WEEKLY TIMER for scheduled operation

audeo: Open the battery door to turn off when not in use
Insert size 312 battery with the flat side up
Close battery door gently to turn on
Allow 1 minute for startup before inserting in ear
Clean daily with the dry cloth provided

more1: Place hearing aid on charger every night
Insert in ear with dome pointing into ear canal
Press button once to change program
Use Oticon ON app to adjust volume and settings

iphone15: Press and hold the side button to turn on
Follow setup assistant to configure language and WiFi
Sign in with your Apple ID or create a new one
Enable Face ID by following the on-screen instructions
Restore from backup or set up as new device

galaxys23: Press and hold the side key to power on
Sign in to your Samsung and Google accounts
Transfer data from old phone using Smart Switch

nitro: Unfold the rollator by pulling up on the seat
Adjust handle height to wrist level when standing
Squeeze brake handles to slow down or stop
Lock brakes by pushing handles down when seated
Fold by lifting the seat and pushing down the frame

alurehab: Open by pulling the two sides apart
Set handle height using the height adjustment buttons
Walk at a comfortable pace behind the rollator
Use loop brakes to control speed on slopes
Store bag items in the provided basket

v15: Charge the vacuum fully before first use (4.5 hours)
Attach the correct cleaning head for your floor type
Press the power button once to start
Use the MAX button for powerful suction on stubborn dirt
Empty the bin when the red indicator shows it is full
v12: Click the wand into the main body
Guide the cleaner head across the floor
Press the bin release to empty after use

completec3: Unwind the power cord fully before use
Select the correct floorhead for your surface
Use the rotary dial to set suction power
Guide the vacuum slowly for best results
Change the dustbag when the indicator turns red

roombaj7: Place the charging base against a wall with clear space
Charge Roomba for 3 hours before first use
Press CLEAN button to start a cleaning job
Use the iRobot app to schedule automatic cleaning
Empty the bin after every 1-2 cleaning sessions
